bounded-exec.description: Run a command with bounded timeout and force-kill behavior

typescript-emit.description: Emit transformed JavaScript and declarations together with ttsc

clean-outputs.description: Remove declared build output directories unless they contain tracked files

cargo-zigbuild.description: Build one Linux binary or cdylib with devenv's zig through cargo-zigbuild and copy it to its output file

shard-timings.description: Fail when a timings-sharded bun test suite runs a file its --timings manifest does not name

all-verdicts.description: Run every command at once to its own verdict and report each one a signal ended or that never ran as UNJUDGED
